mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month (indicating monetary easing) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.2pp over three months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 0.5% from their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansion, a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of early-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO rises by at least 0.3% over the prior month, or the Rank IC in early-cycle periods is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive growth trend in real GDP (GDPC1) signals sustained economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate is above 2.0% year-over-year, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in inflation (CPIAUCSL rising more than 0.3 percentage points over three months) signals potential monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.3pp over three months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth declines by at least 0.2% and UNRATE rises by at least 0.1pp from their 3-month averages, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a further increase in the federal funds rate signals aggressive policy to combat inflation, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5% and rising, or the Rank IC in tightening cycles is below 0.03.
